Why Hisn Al-Muslim?
Hisn Al-Muslim is not a Dhikr-based application only, but it goes beyond to provide full explanation for such Dhikrs, along with audio service, making it easy for you to read, listen and understand all in one. •	Night Mode: Activate night mode for better experience in dark and low-light environments.
